Name: The Teddy Edit
Author: fruitipebbles
Description:
[font=Courier New][b][i]I didn't have nearly enough brown in my game, so...[/i][/b] 

The Teddy Edit adds six new cosy hats and shirts via Content Patcher just in time for winter!

[b]Hats:[/b]
Beanie
Glasses 
﻿Clips
﻿Clip
﻿Barrette
﻿Headband


[b]Shirts:[/b]
﻿Teddy (The OG)
﻿Cardigan
﻿Pullover
﻿Vest
﻿Coveralls
﻿Top
[/font][font=Courier New][b]
installation:[/b]

Requires: SMAPI & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. Non-negotiable.
Recommended: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]
Put it in your mods folder! That's it!

You can spawn in the clothing via CJB Item Spawner linked above and you can also find them at the hat mouse’s as usual. Okay, poke?
[size=1]If using CJB, type "Teddy" into the search bar.[/size]
